# Barnett Architecture

> Barnett Architecture LLC is a full-service, design-focused architectural practice in Madison, Wisconsin, established in 2007 by architect Todd Barnett. It designs new homes, additions, renovations and kitchens, and community, commercial and recreation buildings, mostly in Madison and Wisconsin.

Facts (from the practice's own site):
- Practice: Barnett Architecture LLC (Barnett Architecture), architect Todd Barnett; established 2007.
- Address: 118 North Breese Terrace, Suite I, Madison, WI 53726-4133, United States.
- Phone: 608-233-4538 · Email: todd@barnettarchitecture.com
- Areas served: Madison, Middleton, Fitchburg, Sun Prairie, Verona, Waunakee, Monona, Maple Bluff, McFarland, Cottage Grove, Oregon, Windsor, Belleville and Brooklyn, WI; projects across Wisconsin and in Illinois and New York.
- Services: architectural and building design, custom homes, home additions, remodeling (kitchen, bathroom, basement), accessory dwelling units (ADUs), historic building conservation, sustainable and energy-efficient design, universal design, space planning, construction drawings, 3D rendering.
- Recognition: Best of Houzz — Service, 2014, 2016 and 2018; rated 4.8/5 from 17 reviews on Houzz (https://www.houzz.com/professionals/architects-and-building-designers/barnett-architecture-llc-pfvwus-pf~914672624).
- Approach: Although stylistic examples range from traditional to modern, all projects strive to create places that are well-built, facilitate their intended use and raise the spirit. Design work uses the charrette, green design and universal design.
- Photography: Todd Barnett also photographs the backroads of the Midwest and the highlands of central Mexico; 8 collections are on the site.
